requirements.text: Both Classic and Modern themes shall exist under the themes preferences.
Classic theme shall be displayed as in the given image.
Modern theme shall be displayed as in the given image.
"Theme Preferences" item shall be available under View menu.
"Get New Themes" item shall be available under View menu.
"Classic" item shall be available under View menu.
"Modern" item shall be available under View menu.

reference_cases.title: TC-175
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
From the main menu bar, select Edit > Preferences > Appearance > Themes

EXPECTED RESULTS
By default, there should be at least two skins under Themes -- Classic and Modern.

reference_cases.title: TC-176
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. From the main menu bar, select Edit > Preferences > Appearances > Themes.
2. Select "Classic" theme on the right hand side of the dialog.
3. Click the "Apply Classic" button. 
4. Close the Preferences dialog. 

EXPECTED RESULTS
The following image for the menu bar of the browser should display as follows:

reference_cases.title: TC-177
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. From the main menu bar, select Edit > Preferences > Appearances > Themes.
2. Select "Modern" theme on the right hand side of the dialog.
3. Click the "Apply Modern" button.
4. Close the Preferences dialog.

EXPECTED RESULTS
The folowing image for the menu bar of the browser should display as follows:

reference_cases.title: TC-178
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. From the main menu bar, select View.
2. Select "Apply Theme" and another submenu should pop up.
3. Select "Theme Preferences..."

EXPECTED RESULTS
The following Theme preferences dialog should appear:

reference_cases.title: TC-179
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. From the main menu bar, select View. 
2. Select "Apply Theme" and another submenu should pop up.
3. Select "Get New Themes" item

EXPECTED RESULTS
This should link to http://wp.netscape.com/themes/index.html (netscape browser).
This should link to http://mozilla.org/themes/download/

reference_cases.title: TC-180
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. From the main menu bar, select View.
2. Select "Apply Theme" and another submenu should pop up.
3. Select "Classic Theme" item.

EXPECTED RESULTS
The Classic Skin should appear to the browser menu bar.

reference_cases.title: TC-181
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. From the main menu bar, select View.
2. Select "Apply Theme" and another submenu should pop up.
3. Select "Modern Theme" item.

EXPECTED RESULTS
The Modern skin should appear to the browser menu bar.
